offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures wafer cleaning, electroplating, furnace and advanced packaging equipment for semiconductor manufacturers. Sells systems directly to chipmakers, mainly in China, Korea, Taiwan and the US, and supports them with installation, service and spare parts.

primary_products.value: single-wafer wet cleaning systems; batch wet cleaning systems; electroplating tools; furnace systems; track systems for advanced packaging

primary_services.value: equipment installation; maintenance and repair; spare parts supply; process support

customer_segment.value: B2B: semiconductor foundries, integrated device manufacturers and memory chipmakers

revenue_model.value: product sales: wafer processing equipment sold to chipmakers; service fees: installation, maintenance, spare parts and process support

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds process equipment from purchased components, sold to semiconductor manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: China, South Korea, Taiwan, United States and other Asian markets

specialization.value: related lines: wet cleaning, electroplating, furnace and advanced packaging tools sharing semiconductor fab customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling systems to chipmakers; own locations: local service and support offices near customer fabs

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: export controls on semiconductor equipment under US and Chinese trade rules
